title: LinkedIn Content Funnel for 10K Followers
summary: The creator shares a 14-day result from a challenge of posting 5 times a day on LinkedIn to gain 10,000 followers in 30 days. She breaks down her four-part content funnel strategy, explaining how she targets broad audiences, her ideal customer profile (ICP), builds trust, and leverages top creators.
key_points: The creator set a challenge to post 5 times a day on LinkedIn to reach 10,000 followers in 30 days.
Results after less than 14 days showed over 200k+ impressions.
Part 1: Top of the Funnel (TOFU) posted once a day. Focuses on broad audience topics like personal branding, LinkedIn account growth, and personal storytelling to drive massive impressions.
Part 2: Middle of the Funnel (MOFU) posted twice a day. Targets ICP (tech and startup founders) by speaking directly to their pain points and struggles using their exact language.
Part 3: Bottom of the Funnel (BOFU) posted once a day. Shares results, proof, and case studies to get leads and build audience trust.

Part 4: Breakdown posts (most important part). Takes top 10 creators in the industry, breaks down their strategies with a personal point of view, and mentions the creator to push content to an international audience.
